```{r setup}
source("../analysis/R/kn.R")
al <- read.csv("../analysis/outputs/figures/alt_text.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# one slide body: figure on the left (about 65%), takeaway panel on the right (one big number and short bullets), source line at the bottom
img <- function(name) { a <- al$alt_text[al$figure == name]; stopifnot(length(a) == 1); sprintf("![](../analysis/outputs/figures/%s_deck.png){fig-alt=\"%s\"}
", name, gsub("\"", "'", a)) }
src <- function(x) cat(sprintf("\n::: {.src}\n%s\n:::\n\n", x))
body <- function(fig, big, cap, bullets, source, full = FALSE) {
  cat("
::::: {.body}
:::: {.figarea", if (full) " .full", "}
", img(fig), "
::::
", sep = "")
  if (!is.null(big)) cat(":::: {.take}

[", big, "]{.big}

::: {.bigcap}
", cap, "

:::

", paste0("- ", bullets, collapse = "
"), "

::::
", sep = "")
  cat(":::::
"); src(source)
}
stats <- function(big, cap) { cat("
:::::: {.stats}
"); for (i in seq_along(big)) cat("::::: {.st}
:::: {.big}
", big[i], "

::::
:::: {.bigcap}
", cap[i], "
::::
:::::
", sep = ""); cat("::::::

") }
cards <- function(h, t, n = NULL, class = ".two") { cat("
::::: {.cards ", class, "}
", sep = ""); for (i in seq_along(h)) cat(":::: {.card}
", if (!is.null(n)) sprintf("::: {.n}
%s

:::
", n[i]), "::: {.h}
", h[i], "

:::
::: {.t}
", t[i], "

:::
::::
", sep = ""); cat(":::::

") }
pct <- function(id) paste0(kn(id), "%")
```

##  {.nostyle}

```{r title, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf('
<div class="tslide"><div class="bar"></div>
<div class="ey">Insight deck · public aggregate data, 2018 to early 2026</div>
<div class="tt">Coverage of obesity drugs in Medicaid: what it did, who it reaches, what it could cost</div>
<div class="sub">Wegovy and Zepbound in state Medicaid programs · %s</div>
<div class="nums">
<div class="n"><b>%s</b><span>additional prescriptions per 1,000 enrollees per quarter (%s)</span></div>
<div class="n"><b>%sM</b><span>U.S. adults meet the FDA label criteria (lower bound)</span></div>
<div class="n"><b>$%sM</b><span>five-year net cost for 1 million enrollees; $%s per member per month</span></div></div>
<div class="by">Erick Kiprotich Yegon · Epidemiologist and data scientist</div>
<div class="url">erickyegon.github.io/incretin-access-value</div></div>
', format(Sys.Date(), "%B %Y"), kn("c_att_overall"), kn_ci("c_att_overall"), kn("b_eligible"), kn("e_net5"), kn("e_pmpm")))
```

## The four questions and the answers: who is eligible, what coverage did, who prescribes, and what it could cost

```{r agenda, results='asis'}
cards(h = c("Who is eligible?", "What did coverage do?", "Who prescribes?", "What could it cost?"),
      n = c(paste0(kn("b_eligible"), " million"), paste0(kn("c_att_overall"), " per 1,000"), pct("d_share_pcp"), paste0("$", kn("e_net5"), " million")),
      t = c(paste0("U.S. adults meet the FDA label criteria (lower bound); ", kn("b_medicaid_elig"), " million have Medicaid."),
            paste0("Prescriptions per 1,000 enrollees per quarter (", kn_ci("c_att_overall"), "), robust in all ", sub(" of .*$", "", kn("c_spec_holds")), " estimable alternative analyses."),
            paste0("of 2024 Part D incretin claims came from primary care; nurse practitioners and physician assistants wrote ", pct("d_share_nppa"), "."),
            paste0("net over five years for 1 million enrollees ($", kn("e_pmpm"), " per member per month); the rebate is the largest unknown.")))
src("Sources: NHANES, CMS State Drug Utilization Data and Medicaid enrollment, Medicare Part D Prescribers, Module E budget model. Associations and scenarios, not forecasts.")
```

## Market today: about half of U.S. adults meet the label criteria, and about `r kn("b_glp1_all")` million already use a GLP-1 drug

```{r a2, results='asis'}
body("20_funnel", paste0(kn("b_eligible"), "M"), paste0("U.S. adults meet the label criteria (", kn_ci("b_eligible"), " million), a lower bound"),
     c(paste0(kn("b_medicaid_elig"), " million of them have Medicaid"), paste0(kn("b_glp1_all"), " million adults currently use any GLP-1 drug (modeled)"), "Solid bars are measured; hatched bars are modeled"),
     "Source: NHANES 2021-2023 (measured) and KFF Health Tracking Poll, February 24 to March 2, 2026 (modeled).")
```

## Market today: gross spending reached $`r kn("m_spend_partd_2024")` billion in Part D and $`r kn("m_spend_medicaid_2024")` billion in Medicaid in 2024, before rebates

```{r a3, results='asis'}
body("50_spending_trend", paste0("$", kn("m_spend_medicaid_2024"), "B"), "gross Medicaid spending on these drugs in 2024, before rebates",
     c(paste0("Part D: $", kn("m_spend_partd_2024"), "B, which includes diabetes and other covered uses"), "Ozempic and Mounjaro lead the growth; obesity-labeled brands in orange"),
     "Source: CMS Medicare Part D Spending by Drug and Medicaid Spending by Drug (gross of rebates).")
```

## Landscape: injectables, new oral options, a Medicare Bridge and a $`r kn("x_price_245")` price are arriving while some states end coverage

```{r a4, results='asis'}
cards(h = c("Products and oral options", "Medicare GLP-1 Bridge", paste0("The $", kn("x_price_245"), " price"), "State coverage is changing"),
      t = c("Wegovy (injection and tablets), Zepbound (KwikPen) and Foundayo (tablets) are covered under the Bridge.",
            paste0("A short-term demonstration, ", kn("x_bridge_window"), ", with a $", kn("x_bridge_copay"), " copay (CMS)."),
            paste0("The White House (November 2025) announced a Medicare price of $", kn("x_price_245"), " a month and said state Medicaid programs will have access at those prices."),
            paste0("Several states ended or paused coverage in late 2025 and early 2026. Pipeline: ", kn("p_obesity_studies"), " registered obesity studies, ", kn("p_obesity_phase3_ongoing"), " ongoing Phase 3.")))
src("Sources: CMS Medicare GLP-1 Bridge pages; White House fact sheet, November 2025; state Medicaid documents; ClinicalTrials.gov (registry last updated 2026-10-02).")
```

## Timeline: label changes, state coverage starts and ends, the $`r kn("x_price_245")` price and the Medicare Bridge cluster in 2024 to 2026

```{r a4b, results='asis'}
body("51_timeline", NULL, NULL, NULL, "Sources: FDA Drugs@FDA labels; state Medicaid documents (primary-analysis states); White House fact sheet, November 2025; CMS Medicare GLP-1 Bridge pages.", full = TRUE)
```

## Access: coverage was associated with an estimated `r kn("c_att_overall")` more prescriptions per 1,000 enrollees per quarter

```{r a5, results='asis'}
cat("\n::: {.body}\n::: {.figarea .full}\n", img("10_event_study_primary"), "\n:::\n:::\n", sep = "")
stats(c(kn("c_att_overall"), paste0(kn("c_es_e0"), " to ", kn("c_es_e8")), kn("c_placebo")),
      c(paste0("per 1,000 enrollees per quarter, ", kn_ci("c_att_overall")), "first quarter to eighth, per 1,000 (market growth included)", paste0("placebo effect (", kn_ci("c_placebo"), "): no effect before coverage")))
src(paste0("Source: CMS SDUD and Medicaid enrollment; ", kn("c_states_primary"), " covering and ", kn("c_states_never"), " never-covering jurisdictions. Callaway and Sant'Anna estimator; part of the growth is national market growth."))
```

## Access: `r kn("c_states_primary")` states form the primary analysis, and their prior authorization and BMI rules differ

```{r a6, results='asis'}
body("01_coverage_timing_map", kn("c_pa_states"), "primary states have prior authorization documented (California's is not found in sourced documents)",
     c(paste0("BMI thresholds documented for ", kn("um_bmi"), " of 17 covering states; step therapy for ", kn("um_step")), paste0(kn("c_states_sens"), " more states with uncertain start quarters appear only in a sensitivity analysis")),
     "Source: state Medicaid documents and CMS approvals (docs/sources); criteria table: coverage_um_criteria.csv in the repository.")
```

## Access, robustness: the estimate holds in all `r sub(" of .*$", "", kn("c_spec_holds"))` estimable alternative analyses, from `r kn("c_spec_range")` per 1,000

```{r a7, results='asis'}
body("11_specification_chart", paste0("All ", sub(" of .*$", "", kn("c_spec_holds"))), "estimable alternative analyses give an interval that excludes zero",
     c(paste0("Overall effect ranges ", kn("c_spec_range"), " per 1,000 across them"), "Fee-for-service only is not estimable, so it is not shown"),
     "Source: Module C specification table (95% CIs); orange = primary analysis.")
```

## Access, detail: coverage operates through managed care, so a fee-for-service-only estimate is not reliable

```{r a8, results='asis'}
body("06_managed_care_split", pct("m_sc_mcou_share"), "of South Carolina's observed prescriptions came through managed care in 2025 Q3",
     c(paste0(pct("m_ri_mcou_share"), " in every Rhode Island quarter"), paste0("A managed-care-only estimate is ", kn("c_spec14"), " per 1,000 managed-care enrollees (", kn_ci("c_spec14"), ")")),
     "Source: CMS State Drug Utilization Data, observed (unsuppressed) prescriptions per 1,000 enrollees; gross of rebates.")
```

## Access, detail: in preliminary data, the first withdrawals appear steep and show how fast coverage can reverse

```{r a9, results='asis'}
body("05b_withdrawal_change", pct("c_withdraw_ca"), "California, normalized change in prescriptions after coverage ended (preliminary)",
     c(paste0(pct("c_withdraw_pa"), " in Pennsylvania"), "2026 Q1 is a preliminary quarter; descriptive only, no model"),
     "Source: SDUD 2025 Q4 to 2026 Q1. Normalized change = obesity-labeled change relative to the state's all-drug change. North Carolina's coverage lapsed 2025-10-01 and was reinstated 2025-12-12, so its rebound is not a withdrawal.")
```

## Prescribers: primary care wrote `r kn("d_share_pcp")`% of 2024 Part D incretin claims, nurse practitioners and physician assistants `r kn("d_share_nppa")`%

```{r a10, results='asis'}
body("31_partd_specialty_mix", pct("d_share_pcp"), "of Part D incretin claims came from primary care physicians in 2024",
     c(paste0(pct("d_share_nppa"), " from nurse practitioners and physician assistants"), "Part D reflects diabetes and other covered uses, not obesity-brand adoption"),
     "Source: CMS Medicare Part D Prescribers (rows with at least 11 claims).")
```

## Prescribers: tirzepatide reached `r kn("d_tirz_2024")`% of Part D incretin prescribers by 2024, from `r kn("d_tirz_2022")`% in 2022

```{r a11, results='asis'}
body("33_partd_tirzepatide_adoption", pct("d_tirz_2024"), paste0("of incretin prescribers had a tirzepatide row in 2024, from ", pct("d_tirz_2022"), " in 2022"),
     c("Endocrinology leads adoption; primary care and nurse practitioners and physician assistants follow", "Part D reflects diabetes and other covered uses"),
     "Source: CMS Medicare Part D Prescribers. Share of prescribers with at least one incretin row who also have a tirzepatide row.")
```

## Prescribers: cardiology wrote `r kn("d_wegovy_cardio")`% of Wegovy's Part D claims, against `r kn("d_ozempic_cardio")`% for Ozempic

```{r a12, results='asis'}
body("34_partd_wegovy_vs_ozempic_specialty", pct("d_wegovy_cardio"), paste0("of Wegovy's Part D claims came from cardiology in 2024, against ", pct("d_ozempic_cardio"), " for Ozempic"),
     c(paste0("Wegovy gained a cardiovascular indication in 2024; ", kn("d_wegovy_claims"), " Wegovy claims from ", kn("d_wegovy_prescribers"), " prescribers"), "One year of data: descriptive only"),
     "Source: CMS Medicare Part D Prescribers, 2024. Part D reflects diabetes and other covered uses, not obesity-brand adoption.")
```

## Value: the five-year net cost for 1 million enrollees is $`r kn("e_net5")` million centrally, within $`r kn("e_scen_min")` to $`r kn("e_scen_max")` million

```{r a13, results='asis'}
body("42_cost_by_scenario", paste0("$", kn("e_net5"), "M"), paste0("central five-year net cost ($", kn("e_pmpm"), " per member per month)"),
     c(paste0("Range across scenarios: $", kn("e_scen_min"), "M to $", kn("e_scen_max"), "M"), "Rebates, prior authorization and years 3 to 5 are assumptions; no medical cost offsets"),
     "Source: Module C effects, SDUD gross reimbursement, statutory rebate floor (42 U.S.C. 1396r-8), White House fact sheet.")
```

## Value: the rebate and the uncertainty in the coverage effect move the answer most

```{r a14, results='asis'}
body("40_tornado", paste0(kn("e_rebate_central"), "%"), paste0("central rebate, the midpoint of ", kn("e_rebate_low"), "% (statutory minimum) and ", kn("e_rebate_high"), "% (implied by the $", kn("x_price_245"), " price)"),
     c("Actual net prices are confidential, so the rebate is an assumption", "Each bar moves one input across its range with the others at central values"),
     "Source: Module E one-way sensitivity.")
```

## Value: per enrollee per month, a gross $`r kn("e_gross_pmpm")` becomes $`r kn("e_pmpm")` net at the central rebate and $`r kn("e_announced_pmpm")` at the announced price

```{r a15, results='asis'}
body("41_waterfall_pmpm", paste0("$", kn("e_pmpm")), "net per enrollee per month at the central rebate",
     c(paste0("Gross: $", kn("e_gross_pmpm"), " per enrollee per month"), paste0("$", kn("e_announced_pmpm"), " at the announced $", kn("x_price_245"), " price")),
     "Source: Module E. The rebate step is an assumption; the announced price is a program price, not a confirmed Medicaid net price.")
```

## Trials show average weight loss of `r sub("^-", "", kn("t_attain_1_orforglipron_6_mg"))`% to `r sub("^-", "", kn("t_surmount_1_tirzepatide_15_mg"))`%, set beside a Medicaid net cost of $`r kn("e_per_user_year")` per user per year (context only)

```{r a16, results='asis'}
body("54_trial_weight_change", paste0("$", kn("e_per_user_year")), paste0("net cost per user per year (4.3 fills, MEPS); $", kn("e_per_member_year_cont"), " per member-year of continuous treatment"),
     c("Different populations, durations and doses", "No cost-effectiveness claim is made"),
     "Trials: published abstracts via PubMed (STEP 1, SURMOUNT-1, SURMOUNT-5, ATTAIN-1); MTD = maximum tolerated dose (SURMOUNT-5). Costs: Module E, midpoint rebate, blended Wegovy and Zepbound.")
```

## Recommendations: considerations for a brand or access lead, from the evidence above

```{r a17, results='asis'}
card <- function(x) sprintf("<div class='card'>%s</div>", x); arr <- "<div class='arrow'>&#8594;</div>"
row <- function(a, b, c) cat("<div class='r'>", card(a), arr, card(b), arr, card(c), "</div>\n", sep = "")
cat("\n<div class='rows'><div class='head'><div>Finding</div><div></div><div>So what</div><div></div><div>What a brand or access lead might consider</div></div>\n")
row(paste0("An estimated ", kn("c_att_overall"), " more prescriptions per 1,000 enrollees per quarter, growing over eight quarters"), "Uptake builds over about two years, not at launch", "Plan access support for a multi-year ramp, not a launch spike")
row("Coverage runs through managed care in South Carolina and Rhode Island", "Managed-care organizations decide, as well as state programs", "Aim evidence at managed-care medical and pharmacy directors")
row(paste0("Coverage ended in California and Pennsylvania (", pct("c_withdraw_ca"), " and ", pct("c_withdraw_pa"), ", preliminary)"), "Budget predictability decides whether coverage lasts", paste0("Show a cost range: $", kn("e_pmpm"), " per member per month centrally, $", kn("e_announced_pmpm"), " at the announced price"))
row(paste0("The rebate is unknown and drives the range ($", kn("e_scen_min"), " to $", kn("e_scen_max"), " million)"), "Public data cannot settle net cost", "Check the range against a payer's own net price")
cat("</div>\n")
src("Considerations, not recommendations of a specific action; prescriber findings are in the report. Public aggregate data; no company affiliation or endorsement.")
```

## Appendix: data, methods, limits and links

```{r a18, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("
::: {.applist}
**Data.** CMS Medicaid State Drug Utilization Data and enrollment, Medicare Part D Prescribers, NADAC, NHANES, MEPS, KFF polls, FDA labels and state Medicaid documents; all public aggregate data. %s dbt models, %s tests.

**Methods.** Callaway and Sant'Anna difference-in-differences (staggered adoption) with imputation of suppressed cells; survey-weighted NHANES estimates; ISPOR-style budget impact model with a probabilistic sensitivity analysis.

**Limits.** Gross, not net, of rebates; ten covering states; eligibility is a lower bound; Part D is not obesity use; scenarios, not forecasts.

**Links.** Interactive budget model: <https://erickyegon.github.io/incretin-access-value/budget-model.html> · Report: <https://erickyegon.github.io/incretin-access-value/report.html> · Site: <https://erickyegon.github.io/incretin-access-value/> · Key numbers: <https://erickyegon.github.io/incretin-access-value/data/key_numbers.csv> · Code: <https://github.com/erickyegon/incretin-access-value>

No company affiliation or endorsement. I used AI tools to help write code and documentation. The study design, methods and conclusions are my own, and I verified all results.
:::
", kn("build_models"), kn("build_tests")))
```
